summary_en: Bridgestone completed cancellation of 42,649,100 shares on September 18, 2026, representing 3.5% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. Post-cancellation issued shares total 1,291,387,942.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Bridgestone Corporation completed the cancellation of 42,649,100 ordinary shares on September 18, 2026, pursuant to a resolution passed by the board of directors on February 16, 2026 under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancelled shares represented 3.5% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares (excluding treasury stock) stand at 1,291,387,942.
